run_structure_evaluation: run crystal structure evaluation against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen matching methods
create_ccdc_match_settings: create a CCDC PackingSimilarity object with configurable shell size and hydrogen tolerance settings
test_match_structures: test matching a single predicted crystal structure against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
build_load_target_structures: build a loader that reads experimental CIF files from a directory or cif_path column into target structures
review_compute_structure_matches: review the structure matching evaluation pipeline that processes all predicted crystal structures via CSD or SLURM
